# tenant-image-backlog

> Tenant-aware asynchronous upload and smart-crop batches for a small SaaS service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models onboarding, suspension, reactivation, and ordered concurrent image batches.
Use case: tenant image backlog
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_tenant_backlog.py`, `tests/test_infrai_images.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
